Docs.summary: Sets rate of perceived exertion (RPE) used during the exercise session.

remarks.para: Sets rate of perceived exertion (RPE) used during the exercise session. Values correspond to the Borg CR10 RPE scale and must be in the range 0 to 10 inclusive. 0: No exertion (at rest) 1: Very light 2-3: Light 4-5: Moderate 6-7: Hard 8-9: Very hard 10: Maximum effort Returns builder instance with rate of perceived exertion set.
